How the mentorship works

Five stages, in order — from finding the right product to scaling what's proven to work. Each stage builds on the last.

1

Product research

Identify products with real demand, analyze competition, evaluate suppliers, and understand pricing and margins before you commit to anything.

2

Store setup

Build a professional Shopify store with a strong product page, a trustworthy design, mobile optimization, and a clear path from landing to checkout.

3

Marketing & testing

Approach organic and paid marketing with a plan — build and test creatives, understand your audience, and read campaign data properly instead of guessing.

4

Optimization

Learn to read the numbers, find where customers are dropping off, and improve the offer, store, or creative based on evidence, not hunches.

5

Scaling

Once something proves it can work, scale the system carefully — not by blindly increasing spend, but by improving what's already working.

Knowing something and actually implementing it correctly are two different things.

Learning from videos and information is useful — but it's rarely where people get stuck. Most people already know roughly what to do. What's missing is guidance while they're doing it, and someone to tell them why a decision matters before they've made an expensive version of it.

This mentorship exists so you don't spend months jumping between strategies, testing blindly, or repeating mistakes that are avoidable with the right direction. You'll understand why you're doing something, not just follow steps — and have guidance through the parts that are actually hard to get right on your own.
